messages:
alex: Quick q — when a canary route returns a degraded response (model fallback), what handshake/status should we return to clients? want a consistent lexicon for SDKs and console tooling. current options we keep seeing: 1) 200 + body.meta.fallback, 2) 3xx redirect-like signal, 3) 503 with hint. thoughts?

maria: i'd prefer 200 + clear headers + body flag. most customers ignore body meta. header is easiest to surface in proxies & logging. :thumbsup:

tarun: header + body field + telemetry tag. suggestion: X-Redwood-Route-Status: degraded|ok|fallback and X-Redwood-Route-Variant: canary|stable. also emit telemetry.event = route_handshake.

alex: header sounds good. main concern: SDK contract. if we return 200 for degraded, SDKs must still expose a deterministic enum or error-class, otherwise apps silently degrade.

melissa: agreed. SDK should expose Response.route_status {OK, DEGRADED, FALLBACK} and a boolean isFallback. also add client-visible retry hint for quota/backpressure: Retry-After or X-Redwood-Retry-Hint.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: model=grok-mini v2->v3, weight=5% @canary

maria: console UX: do we need a 'handshake' column on per-route dashboard? i think so — show last-route-status + percent degraded in last 1h. also map status to badge severity (info/warn/error).

tarun: telemetry payload should include: route_status, model_variant, latency_bucket, token_count, rollout_weight. that feeds Optimize for quantization/replication recommendations.

alex: security note: don't expose internal route ids. use a stable public badge like X-Redwood-Route-Badge: rb_<hash>. avoid leaking hostnames or cluster names.

melissa: rollout UX idea: while canary <10% surface console banner: "Canary in progress — degraded responses possible" and set opt-in header X-Redwood-Client-Opt: accept-degraded=true so clients can opt into relaxed semantics during rollout testing.

maria: good. final ask: agree to a minimal shipped spec? propose headers: X-Redwood-Route-Status (ok|degraded|fallback), X-Redwood-Route-Badge (rb_XXXXX), X-Redwood-Retry-Hint (none|retry-after|no-retry). body path: .meta.route_hint for backward compatibility. SDK mapping: expose enum + isFallback + telemetry tag. i'll draft RFC after we align.

alex: +1 on the spec. maria pls cc eng-runtime, eng-sdk, and product before RFC goes live. thanks all. :rocket:
